description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (55), grants [Astra] and [Stoneskin: 30%], grants [Haste] and [Burst Mode] to the user

description.name: Astra
description.text: Prevents Poison, Silence, Paralyze, Confuse, Slow, Stop, Blind, Sleep, Petrify, Berserk, Sap and Stun once

description.name: Stoneskin: 30%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 30% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Burst Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands, ATK, DEF, MAG, RES, MND, ACC and EVA +20%, SPD +10%
